candidates.final_prompt: Use case: photorealistic natural website share image. Asset type: 1.91:1 Open Graph candidate, atmosphere-only brand default. Primary request: create a refined studio still life of exactly three genuine-looking dried carob pods on a seamless pale powder-blue surface and matching pale-blue background. Reference use: use the botanical reference only for dry irregular pod morphology and the blue reference only for palette and tonal atmosphere. Do not reproduce the powder, wood or rustic set from the botanical reference. Composition: wide horizontal frame with an asymmetrical central cluster, one pod crossing lightly behind another, broad quiet negative space, and a strong silhouette that survives a tiny thumbnail and a centered square crop. Lighting: cool restrained directional light from upper left, long elegant soft-edged shadows, low glare. Materials: pods are dry dark natural brown, wrinkled, unevenly ridged, scarred, subtly chipped and naturally asymmetrical, with almost no specular sheen. Constraints: no product pieces, packaging, wrappers, labels, logos, text, claims, people, faces, hands, branches, foliage, flowers, powder, linen, wood, patterns, marble, resin, glossy plastic, accessories, watermark or border. No duplicated pods. Photographic realism, not CGI.
candidates.visual_qa: Full-resolution source and 1200 by 630 master inspected; wide, centered square and thumbnail crops preserve the main pod cluster.
known_limitations: Studio highlights make the foremost pod slightly shinier than an ideal fully dry matte pod.
